settings.heading: Small Guy. Big Ideas.
settings.text: He is not the expert. He is the fan — curious about comics, games, music, design, food, tech and whatever comes next.

settings.heading: We grew up. The culture came with us.
settings.text: CVRBOY is fashion for people raised by nerd culture — not costume, not merch, not a gatekeeping club. Good clothes first. The reference is there if you know.
